column1: # AQL Language Specification: Minimal Failing Prefixes — COMPILE FAILURES (GENERATED)
# format: front-coded
# format: detail-legend
# Format: FRONT-CODED with a DETAIL LEGEND. Each data row is
# reuse<TAB>suffix<TAB>code, where reuse = the count of leading bytes the
# prefix shares with the previous row's prefix (full prefix =
# prevPrefix[:reuse]+suffix) and code indexes the `# detail N:` legend
# below. The constant `compile-refused:` disposition prefix (and the documentary
# full-matrix result) are hoisted out of every row.
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate with `make spec-gen` (specgen -frontier mode).
# A MINIMAL FAILING PREFIX is a sequence that fails while its immediate
# prefix passes — the exact atom at which a passing program first breaks.
# Every non-passing combination truncates to one of these (the trailing
# atoms after the break are discarded) and DUPLICATES ARE REMOVED, so this
# is the deduped catalogue of distinct failure points.
# Scope: prefixes drawn from combinations of length 1..4.
# These prefixes PASS THE TYPE CHECKER but the bytecode compiler will not
# lower them (CompileCheck returns no Program); the note gives the first
# offender / refusal reason. They run correctly via the interpreter.
# 3294 prefixes.
# detail 0: residual shape beyond Stage 1 (call result above a literal)
# detail 1: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at dup
# detail 2: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at drop
# detail 3: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at not
# detail 4: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at size
# detail 5: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at add
# detail 6: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at sub
# detail 7: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at mul
# detail 8: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at eq
# detail 9: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at and
# detail 10: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at swap
# detail 11: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at lt
# detail 12: polymorphic dispatch at dup
